name: luna-shopper-gateway
comment: Runtime dependency manifest for the container image. Development uses the single root package.json (plan 0003); this is the authoritative list of what the built service needs at runtime, so `nx prune` produces a pruned package.json + lockfile for a reproducible `npm ci` in the Dockerfile (plan 0002, section 3). Includes the deps the bundled @portfolio/luna-shopper/platform code pulls in (pino/terminus/swagger/throttler/class-validator). Keep in sync with the imports the service actually uses.
